Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This procedure outlines the testing procedures P1, to be carried out on an 
annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
The first draft initiated by eng, Ayda Otafey, 
tested by eng Mohamed Rabee, accepted by general director eng. Hamdy Dorgam, 
approved by eng. Gaber Farahat head sector of Damanhour power station and 
and
certified by eng. Sania 
Attia Diab WDEPC Inspection head sector and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear your safety and 
 healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.
Unit must be shutdown.
Circuit breaker open and 
 local.
Tools and Equipment
Use suitable tools
Instrument secondary 
 injection test
Avometer
Work to be carried out
Preparation
Isolate the secondary 
 terminals of VT
Testing the Relay
Open the links on 
 terminals (64,67) to isolate the VT secondary circuit
Connect test leads 
 between the test set and the voltage terminal (1&2) for the relay.
Connect test leads 
 between the test set and the time terminal (15&16) for the relay.
Increase the voltage 
 gradually until the first stage value .
Record the voltage value 
 in the test sheet and the time .
Decrease the injection 
 voltage gradually to zero .
Make sure CT and PT 
 secondary circuits are in normal condition .
